newsitem.title: INDIA: Yield at Indian repos auction steady at 4.90 pct.
newsitem.headline: Yield at Indian repos auction steady at 4.90 pct.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) said on Saturday it set a cut-off rate of 4.90 pct at its four-day repos of government of India securities held earlier in the day, unchanged from the previous auction.
RBI received 59 bids amounting to 48.90 billion rupees, out which it accepted 44 bids for 36.65 billion rupees.
It said the weighted average interest rate was 4.7831 percent against 4.7349 percent at the previous auction on Wednesday.
